title: Direct Zombie
description: A root-linked scheduled execution remains active.
concept: Disabling the root does not terminate a consequence already in motion.

title: Transitive Zombie
description: A child delegation created a still-active schedule.
concept: Evidence lineage can carry a blocker beyond the root identity boundary.

title: Pending Commitment
description: A reachable purchase commitment has not settled.
concept: A surviving commitment can prevent bounded operational closure.

title: Retained Evidence
description: Retained state is present, inert, and no longer linked to the root.
concept: Closure does not require deletion of inert retained evidence.

title: Successor Transfer
description: Responsibility is accepted by a successor and the old-root linkage has ended.
concept: Closure of the retiring root is distinct from global deletion.

title: Missing Coverage
concept: No observed blocker is not the same as established closure.

title: False Success
description: A reported cancellation success conflicts with the observed postcondition.
concept: Reported operation success does not override observed state.

title: Fixed-Point Wind-Down
description: Four scans expose expansion, terminal qualification, and confirmation.
concept: One clean observation is not stable convergence.
